notes: Pass 1 (CWE-22/23/36/73 Path Traversal) labeling of copyparty 1.8.1 'argon' (copyparty_vuln source tree, 22079 LOC in the shipped copyparty/ package).

Labeling performed by the in-session LLM itself (glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI) in 8 logical batches (s1-s4 sources, k1-k4 sinks) after first-hand source reading of httpcli.py, authsrv.py, util.py, up2k.py, ftpd.py, smbd.py, th_srv.py and __main__.py; no external LLM API calls were made.

Dedup policy: candidates merged on (file, line, callable, flowKind, argIndex, receiver); api/ast double rows for the same call site (json.loads, os.environ.get, os.path.join, and identical duplicate CSV rows) collapse into one entry with merged matchKinds recorded in labels_raw_pass1.json.

Sources were accepted only at true input boundaries: the hand-rolled HTTP socket parser (self.req/self.vpath/self.uparam/self.headers/self.cookies, json/form/multipart), the pyftpdlib-dispatched FTP params and SMB callbacks. Internal params, boot env vars and file-derived JSON were labeled none/fp.

Sinks were accepted only for actual file reads/writes/deletes/creates/content-serves (open, bos.open, ren_open, yieldfile, tx_file/tx_md, Image.open, unlink/rename/mkdir, sendfile, scandir, stat-family at reduced confidence); os.path.join/resolve were labeled summary (taint-preserving propagation, NOT sinks).

Sanitizers labeled only with concrete verified evidence: undot (authsrv.py:473 post-decode application inside VFS.get - the load-bearing guard), sanitize_fn (basename-only), chk_ap (opt-in prefix containment for xdev/xvol volumes). The PRE-decode undot at httpcli.py:333/337 is labeled candidate because it is unsound against percent-encoded traversal (decode happens after at :375).

Key finding candidate carried into the labels: the .cpr static-resource read channel (httpcli.py:766-783) slices the decoded self.vpath without the second undot and joins it onto E.mod/web/ before tx_file - encoded traversal survives the pre-decode undot there. All other read channels resolve through VFS.get's post-decode undot.

Per the experimental contract, no ground truth (VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md, enhanced_path_sinks.csv, path_traversal_sinks.csv, tests/), patch diffs or CVE data were consulted; only the copyparty package sources were read.
